viewer: Hindi-speaking 16-30 year olds with roots in villages and summer trips to nani-nana's gaon
hook: A huge peepal at night with red threads swaying: Gaon mein kehte hain, peepal ke neeche raat ko mat sona.
payoff: Monu slept under it; next morning he stares at a black thread with his name and today's date.
cta: Ped ka naam likho: Peepal, Imli, Bargad.
sources: Original story built on common North Indian folk belief about peepal trees at night. Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS (Aman), studio-synthesized SFX/BGM. No third-party footage or audio.
